get.description: Liveness and dependencies: the database and the object store.
Sets the CSRF cookie (the middleware does it for any response without one). Call once at start-up.

Who is signed in: `{"me": Me}`, or `{"me": null}` for a guest. Never 401, so a guest's page load logs no
error (student test ST-10); GET /me still answers 401 when signed out.

post.description:
Send a code to an email address or phone number. The same answer whether or not an account exists.

The code is 6 digits; after many wrong codes for an address it is 10 letters and digits instead
(`codeFormat: "long"`, written 'ABCDE-FGH23'), which nobody can guess.

Errors: invalid_identifier (422), sms_unavailable (422: a number we don't text; 429: texts paused), rate_limited
(429, with retryAfter), delivery_failed (503: try again or use the other method).

Check the code; on success the account is created if needed and the session cookie is set (with a CSRF
cookie bound to it: read it again before the next request).

Errors: invalid_code (422, with attempts left in the message), code_expired (410), too_many_attempts (429).
End this browser's session (no error when not signed in). The CSRF cookie is replaced too.

get.description: The signed-in user (401 when signed out). GET /auth/session answers the same without a 401 for guests.

delete.description:
Delete the account: personal data goes, posts stay as 'deleted user', published files stay unattributed.

Errors: step_up_required (403), last_admin (409: the only active admin stays), storage_unavailable (503: files
could not be deleted, nothing changed).

patch.description:
Display name, cohort year and email switches. Only the fields sent change; `year: null` clears it.

Errors: invalid_display_name (422), forbidden (403: a suspended account can't change its name).

get.description: Everything the Hub stores about the signed-in user.
Browsers signed in to this account, most recently used first.

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api V1 Me Sessions Get

delete.description: Sign out one browser (use /auth/logout for this one; if it is this one, its cookie is cleared too).

post.description:
Send a code to one of the account's own identifiers: `via` "email" or "phone" (by default the email
address, else the phone number). Check it with POST /me/step-up/verify.

Errors: invalid_input (422: the account has no such identifier), sms_unavailable, rate_limited,
delivery_failed, as for POST /auth/otp.

Check the code sent by POST /me/step-up. On success this browser gets a new session (and a new CSRF cookie:
read it again), with which changing identifiers and deleting the account work for `expiresIn` seconds.

Errors: invalid_code (422), code_expired (410), too_many_attempts (429).

Add the other kind of identifier (a phone number to an email account, or the reverse), or change one: a code
goes to the new address.

The answer is the same whether or not another account uses the identifier: if one does, the address gets a
message saying so instead of a code (so nobody can test which addresses have accounts), and
/me/identifiers/verify answers identifier_taken. Errors: identifier_unchanged (409) when it is already this
account's, step_up_required (403), plus those of POST /auth/otp.

Check the code sent by POST /me/identifiers/otp and put the identifier on the account. The account's other
sessions are signed out, and the identifier it replaces (or, for an addition, the other one) gets a notice.

Errors: invalid_code (422), code_expired (410), too_many_attempts (429), identifier_taken (409).

delete.description:
Remove the email address or the phone number; the account must keep at least one (last_identifier, 409).
The account's other sessions are signed out and the removed identifier gets a notice.

Errors: step_up_required (403), last_identifier (409).

put.description:
Mark one lesson watched or not (404 when there is no such lesson). A study-board card for a watched lesson
moves to Done.
The lesson the student just opened in its module (404 when it does not exist).

delete.description: Forget the watched lessons and the last lesson of one module.

post.description: Merge progress kept in the browser as a guest (unknown lessons are skipped, newest timestamps win).

get.description: Newest first, with the unread count.

Counts for the moderation dashboard: visible threads and replies, published library items, uploads waiting
for review, the open reports in the viewer's queue and the requests waiting for an answer (for people who handle
them). A feature switched off for the viewer counts None.

Search by name (case-insensitive, any part), newest accounts first. `role`: a role's slug. Only admins search
and see email addresses and phone numbers (a phone number may be typed with spaces).

Errors: invalid (422: no role with this slug).

patch.description:
Suspend or restore an account, or recover one (security review SEC-9): replace or remove its email
address or phone number. Only the fields sent change; everything is audited and the person gets a notification.
Recovery also ends every session of the account and sends a notice to the address that was replaced or removed.
Recovery, and suspending or restoring an admin, need a recent step-up; recovery never applies to an account holding
Admin (security review AD-1).

Errors: cannot_change_self (409), last_admin (409: the only active admin), forbidden (403: recovery is for admins,
and so is suspending or restoring an admin; nobody recovers an admin's account), step_up_required (403: recovery,
or suspending or restoring an admin), identifier_taken (409), last_identifier (409), invalid_identifier (422).

put.description:
The roles the person holds afterwards, exactly. They're told. Errors: step_up_required (403),
cannot_change_self (409), last_admin (409: the only active admin keeps Admin), invalid_input (422: a role that
doesn't exist), rate_limited (429). Audited.

get.description: Who did what, newest first.
Every role with its boxes and how many people hold it, and every box with its area and label.

post.description:
Errors: step_up_required (403), invalid_input (422: another role has this name or badge, or the badge passes
for staff), rate_limited (429). Audited.

patch.description:
Send the `version` you loaded. Errors: step_up_required (403), role_locked (409: Admin), role_changed (409:
changed since you loaded it), invalid_input (422: as for a new role, or a box beyond the student-level ones on
Student), rate_limited (429). Audited.

delete.description:
Its holders lose it and are told. Errors: step_up_required (403), role_locked (409: a built-in role),
role_in_use (409: a feature switch is on for it), rate_limited (429). Audited.

schema.title: Response List Features Api V1 Admin Features Get

put.description:
Off, on for some roles (`roleIds`), or on for everyone. Errors: step_up_required (403), invalid_input (422: no
roles, or a role that doesn't exist), rate_limited (429). Audited.

get.description: Every module, in programme order, with its published library count (None while the library is off for you).

schema.title: Response List Modules Api V1 Modules Get

get.description: Every module, hidden ones too, by year and then in programme order.

schema.title: Response Modules For Editing Api V1 Content Modules Get

A new, empty module at the end of its year. Its `id` is its address, for good. Audited.

Errors: slug_taken (409), invalid_input (422: a unit code another module has, a link that isn't https://).
One year's modules in a new order. Audited. Errors: module_changed (409: they aren't that year's modules).

schema.title: Response Reorder Modules Api V1 Content Modules Reorder Post

get.description: A module as the editor has it: hidden chapters and lessons too, each with its `id` and video link.

put.description:
Saves the whole module. Chapters and lessons keep their ids, so what refers to a lesson (progress, notes,
study-board cards) stays with it when it moves or is hidden. Audited, with what changed before and after.

Errors: module_changed (409: someone saved it since `version`, or a chapter or lesson `id` that isn't the module's),
content_in_use (409: removing a chapter that still has lessons, or a lesson with notes or cards: hide it),
invalid_input (422: a video link the app can't embed, a unit code another module has, a link that isn't
https://).

delete.description:
Removes a module nothing refers to. Audited.

Errors: module_changed (409), content_in_use (409: it has lessons, files, threads, notes, cards, requests or
calendar dates; hide it instead).

get.description:
Published items for everyone. `starred` and `mine` need a session; `mine` includes pending and rejected.
`q` searches titles, descriptions, authors and file names, plus the module's code and name and the kind
("ST2133 past papers"), and the words inside PDF and Word files (those found only there come after the rest,
with `match`: the words around them and the page); the last word matches as a prefix.

post.description:
Turn a completed upload into a library item: pending for students, published for library managers.

Errors: not_uploaded (409), already_used (409), too_many_pending (409: the student already has 10 files waiting
for review), invalid_input (422: an unknown module), feature_off (404: library uploads are switched off).

get.description: By slug. Unpublished items: only their uploader and the library's managers.

post.description: A link to a resource kept elsewhere (https only), published at once.

patch.description: The uploader while the item is pending; library managers always.

delete.description:
The uploader or a library manager. Nothing serves the file any more; the daily sweep deletes it from storage
a week later.

get.description: 302 to a short-lived link that downloads the file (counted), or to the link's URL.

A short-lived link that shows the file in the browser (PDFs and images), for the viewer. Not counted.

Errors: no_preview (409) for links and other formats: download them instead.

post.description:
Publish or reject a pending upload. Notifies the uploader. Audited. A rejected file is deleted from storage a
week later (the item and its note stay).

Errors: removed (409), file_gone (409: publishing a file that was rejected more than a week ago).

A presigned POST for one file. library: PDF, Word (.docx, .doc), Excel (.xlsx, .xls), PowerPoint (.pptx,
.ppt), notebooks (.ipynb), R scripts (.r), text (.txt), CSV and pictures (.jpg, .jpeg, .png, .webp), up to
DSBA_MAX_UPLOAD_MB; forum_image: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF up to DSBA_MAX_IMAGE_MB. The extension must match the
declared type (for .ipynb and .r, `application/octet-stream` is accepted too). POST `fields` and then the file
as `file` to `url`, then call /uploads/{id}/complete. 20 uploads per hour.

Errors: unsupported_type (422), too_large (422), too_many_pending (409: a student already has 10 files waiting
for review; library only), rate_limited (429), forbidden (403: no library.upload, or no forum.post for a forum
picture), feature_off (404: the library, its uploads or the forum is switched off).

Call after the browser's POST to the bucket succeeded: checks the object exists and that its size, type and
first bytes match the file's name.

Errors: not_uploaded (409), mismatch (422; the object is deleted), feature_off (404: the upload's feature was
switched off since it started).

get.description:
A forum image: 302 to a short-lived link (cache headers allow browsers to reuse it for a few minutes). 404 when
the post it belongs to is hidden or deleted, except for moderators.
Categories and tags (the server validates threads against these).
Counts for the tabs and chips, replies since midnight (Bahrain) and the week's top contributors.

Pinned threads first (when not searching), then by `sort`. Hidden threads are left out (moderators see them);
deleted ones stay listed, without their text, while they have replies. `year`: that cohort's threads (its
category, or a module of that year) plus forum-wide ones (study groups and general without a module).
`hot` = (votes + 1.5 * replies) / (age in hours + 2)^1.5.

The author upvotes their own thread. Forum images in the body (/api/v1/media/<id>) are attached.

`anonymous` (needs forum.anonymous): students see "A Year N student" in place of the author, everywhere the
thread shows, and in its notifications. The author and those who moderate the forum (forum.moderate) still see
who it is, and the audit log records it (forum.thread.anonymous). Reports and rate limits apply as usual.
`seniorId` (needs career.seniors): a listed senior asked from Career Navigator; they are notified.

Errors: rate_limited (429) after 10 threads in an hour; feature_off (404) for `anonymous` or `seniorId` while
their feature is off; invalid_input (422: the senior isn't taking questions).

get.description: The hottest threads (pinned ones excluded), for Home and the newsletter.

schema.title: Response Hot Threads Api V1 Forum Threads Hot Get

get.description:
By slug. Replies oldest first.

Hidden threads and replies are for moderators and for their own author: the author gets them with status
'hidden' and canModerate false (show them a "hidden by a student rep" banner) and can't change them (canEdit
false). Everyone else: 404 for a hidden thread; a hidden reply is left out of `replies`.

patch.description: The author (or a moderator) edits the thread; edited_at is set. The slug never changes.

delete.description:
The author (or a moderator) deletes the thread: its text goes; its title and replies stay listed while it has
replies. A hidden thread stays hidden (only reps reach it) and unhiding it later gives a deleted thread.

get.description: Same module first, then shared tags and category. Works on any thread the viewer can open.

schema.title: Response Related Threads Api V1 Forum Threads  Thread Id  Related Get

put.description:
Follow a thread: 'answers' (an accepted answer), 'replies' (every reply too) or 'off'. Voting for a thread or
replying in it starts at 'answers', unless you switched it off. The thread's author follows it already.
Upvote (idempotent). Errors: post_unavailable (409) for deleted and hidden threads.

post.description:
The thread's author (or a moderator) marks a reply as the answer, or clears it. The answer is a visible,
top-level reply by someone other than the thread's author. Notifies the reply's author.

Pin, lock (no new replies) or hide a thread. Hiding tells the author (a "system" notification, with `reason`
when given); unhiding a thread that was deleted while hidden gives a deleted thread. Audited.

Notifies the thread's author (and the parent reply's author), linking to /forum/<slug>#reply-<id>.

Errors: thread_locked (409: locked by a student rep), post_unavailable (409: the thread was deleted or hidden),
rate_limited (429).

delete.description:
The author (or a moderator) deletes a reply: it keeps its place without its text, and the notifications about
it are taken back. A hidden reply stays hidden (only reps reach it).

post.description:
Hide a reply (its author is told, with `reason` when given; the notifications about it are taken back), or
show it again (a reply deleted while hidden comes back deleted). Audited.

Report a thread, reply, library item or request (one open report per person and target).

Errors: not_found (404) when the target doesn't exist or the reporter can't see it, already_reported (409),
rate_limited (429), feature_off (404: the forum, the library or requests are switched off).

get.description:
Open reports oldest first (a queue); closed ones most recently closed first. Each person sees the reports they
can act on: forum posts with forum.moderate, library files with library.manage, requests with requests.manage,
each while its feature is on for them. `reporter` is set for admins only (student reps are classmates).

post.description:
Close a report (hiding the post is a separate moderation call). Notifies the reporter. Audited.

Errors: not_found (404) when the report isn't in this person's queue, report_closed (409) when it was already
closed.

get.description:
Requests, the most wanted first (`sort=me_too`) or the newest first. A signed-in student's own requests come
first either way; `mine=true` lists only theirs. `q` searches titles and details.

post.description:
Ask for something. Errors: invalid_input (422: a short title, an unknown module), rate_limited (429: five a
day).

get.description:
Up to five requests that share a word with `q`: the hint shown while a student types a title, so they can
say "me too" instead of asking again.

Say "me too". Saying it twice changes nothing. Errors: not_found (404), own_request (409), request_closed
(409: done or declined).

delete.description: Take back a "me too". Errors: not_found (404), own_request (409).

Set the status (open, planned, done, declined) and the public reply. Declining needs a reply. A new status
notifies the requester and everyone who said "me too". Audited (`request.status`).

Errors: not_found (404), invalid_input (422: declined without a reason).

Published issues, newest first (drafts too for people who manage the newsletter and ask for them; ignored for
everyone else).

post.description:
A draft. Errors: slug_taken (409); invalid_input (422: the content doesn't fit the schema, a link isn't
https://, mailto: or a page of the Hub, or the issue is over 256 KB of JSON).

get.description: An issue with its sections and the reactions to each section. Drafts: for people who manage the newsletter.

Edit a draft or a published issue (fields that are not sent stay as they are; `sections` and `cover` are
replaced as a whole). Errors: slug_taken (409), poll_has_votes (409: a poll's answers changed after it got
votes), invalid_input (422).

Publishes the issue and tells every account in the Hub. It also goes by email to those who keep "New
newsletter issues" on, unless an issue email went out in the last 24 hours: `emailed` says which. Audited.
Publishing an issue that is already out changes nothing.

put.description: Idempotent. Published issues only. Errors: not_found (404: no such issue or section).

One vote per person, and it can't be changed. The counts come back with it. Published issues only.
Errors: already_voted (409), poll_closed (409), not_found (404: no such issue or poll), invalid_input (422: no
such answer).

Your notes, last edited first, each with the start of its body. `q` searches titles and bodies; `module_id`
keeps one module's notes, and `lesson_id` one lesson's.

post.description:
A new note. Errors: invalid_input (422: an unknown module or lesson, or too long), too_many_notes (409),
rate_limited (429).

Save the whole note. Send the `version` you loaded: if it was saved since (another tab), 409 note_changed;
load it again, or send its new version to save yours over it. Errors: rate_limited (429: saving very fast).

get.description:
Events between `from` and `to` (inclusive; an event spanning several days counts if it overlaps), for a
cohort plus everyone-events, oldest first.

A new date. The id is '<date>-<slug of the title>'. For a module's event the cohort defaults to the
module's year; leave `year` out (or null without a module) for everyone.

`type=exam` gives only the exams (the web app's "Download the exams").

One event as an iCalendar file to import ("Add to calendar"): all-day, with a reminder the day before an exam
or a deadline. Errors: not_found (404).

Fields that are not sent stay as they are; `endDate`, `time`, `place`, `year` and `moduleId` can be
cleared with null. The id never changes. With `notify`, a new date, time or place of an exam, mock or deadline,

Threads, library items, newsletter issues, modules and calendar events. Prefix-matches the last word
(for search-as-you-type). Only public things are found: visible threads, published files and issues.
Features switched off for the viewer are left out.
The Year 3 students taking questions: name, cohort, badge, topics and their line. Never contact details.

The features on for whoever asks: for a guest, those switched on for everyone. Signed in, the same list as

Every card, To do first, each column in its order. Linked things are read as they are now; a thing that's

A card at the end of its column; a lesson already watched goes to Done. Errors: board_full (409),

days. Planning the module again keeps its cards, adds what's missing and takes the new date. Errors:

Ask Mini Noora. The answer streams as Server-Sent Events. Only counts are stored: never the question, the
note or the answer. The note goes only when the student ticked "Include my note".

The limits, and the questions, tokens and estimated cost today and this month. Nothing per student.

Admins only. Audited (`noora.limits`).

This week's Sunday summary for `year` (Sunday to Saturday, Bahrain time) as plain text with links, and how

ModuleSave.description:
The whole module as the editor has it. `version` is the one loaded: if someone saved since, 409
module_changed. Chapters and lessons keep their `id` (a lesson may move to another chapter of the module); one
left out is removed.

MySenior.title: MySenior
MySenior.description: The signed-in person's listing, and whether they may have one (Year 3 only).

NooraErrorEvent.title: NooraErrorEvent
NooraErrorEvent.description:
The answer stopped. `code` is noora_unavailable: what came so far may be shown, with a line that it was cut
off.

NooraNote.title: NooraNote
NooraNote.description: The note open in the editor. Sent only when the student ticks "Include my note" for this question.

NooraQuestion.title: NooraQuestion
NooraQuestion.description: A question, and what's on the student's screen. The server looks the module and lesson up itself.

NooraStatus.title: NooraStatus
NooraStatus.description: Whether her AI answers work for this student now, and how many questions are left today.

NooraTurn.title: NooraTurn
NooraTurn.description: An earlier message of the conversation, so a follow-up question makes sense.

NooraUsageOut.title: NooraUsageOut
NooraUsageOut.description: The limits and the totals, for Manage's numbers. Nothing per student: only counts.

NoteUpdate.title: NoteUpdate
NoteUpdate.description: The whole note as it is now, and the version it was loaded at.

OtpStartRequest.title: OtpStartRequest
OtpStartRequest.description: An email address or a phone number (local Bahraini numbers need no country code).

PollBlock.title: PollBlock
PollBlock.description:
A question to the cohort with two to five answers: one vote per signed-in student, and the counts once you
have voted (needs the newsletter.polls feature). `id` keeps its votes: it is unique in the issue and stays put
once the issue is out.

PollResult.title: PollResult
PollResult.description: A poll's votes. Nobody sees who voted.

Preferences.title: Preferences
Preferences.description:
Which notifications also come by email, to the account's email address, and whether the Sunday summary does.
In the Hub every notification shows whatever these say, and account security notices are always emailed. Unset
means the default here.

PresignedUpload.title: PresignedUpload
PresignedUpload.description: POST a multipart form to `url`: every entry of `fields` first, then the file as `file`.

ProgressImport.title: ProgressImport
ProgressImport.description:
Progress kept in the browser before signing in, merged into the account once (newest wins). `watched` is by
lesson id and `last` by module id. At most 5000 watched lessons and 100 modules (security review, finding 19).

RequestAnswer.title: RequestAnswer
RequestAnswer.description: A status and the public reply that goes with it. Declining needs a reply: the reason.

ResourcesIn.title: ResourcesIn
ResourcesIn.description: The module's shared folders: https:// links (empty or null for none).

RoleUpdate.title: RoleUpdate
RoleUpdate.description: Only the fields sent change; `badge: null` removes the badge, and `boxes` replaces them as a whole.

Senior.title: Senior
Senior.description: A listed senior: name, cohort and badge, the topics and their line. No contact details.

SessionState.title: SessionState
SessionState.description: GET /auth/session: the signed-in user, or null for a guest. Never 401.

SignoffBlock.title: SignoffBlock
SignoffBlock.description: The editors' sign-off at the end of a story or an issue, shown with their avatars.

StatsAside.title: StatsAside
StatsAside.description: A few numbers beside the copy.

StepUpResult.title: StepUpResult
StepUpResult.description:
The browser's session was renewed: changing or removing an identifier and deleting the account work without
another code for `expires_in` seconds.

StepUpStart.title: StepUpStart
StepUpStart.description: Which of the account's own identifiers gets the code: by default the email address, else the phone number.

SummaryPreview.title: SummaryPreview
SummaryPreview.description:
A year's Sunday summary for this week, as plain text with links: what the email says above its footer, and
what a rep pastes into the year's group.

TextMatch.title: TextMatch
TextMatch.description: Where a search's words were found inside the file: the words around them, and the page (PDFs).

UserPublic.title: UserPublic
UserPublic.description: How a person appears next to their posts and uploads.

Video.title: Video
Video.description:
A lesson: one video of a chapter. `id` is the lesson's own, for good: its address is
/modules/<module id>/lessons/<id>.
